Put these two files in this folder before building the App Store / Play Store app.
The game uses them first and only falls back to the internet when they're missing,
so with them here the app works offline and downloads no code when it starts.

  three.min.js   from  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js
  peerjs.min.js  from  https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js

On iPhone: open each link in Safari, tap Share > Save to Files, then add the file
to this vendor folder in Textastic (keep the exact file names above).
